newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy debt payments to fall 7.1 pct in 97 -Isco.
newsitem.headline: Italy debt payments to fall 7.1 pct in 97 -Isco.

text.p: Italy's debt servicing costs will fall to 180.2 trillion lire this year from 194 trillion lire in 1996, state economic research institute Isco said in a report Saturday.
The government's official three-year economic plan, published last year, forecast that debt servicing costs would total 192.4 trillion lire in 1997.
Isco also said that the total tax burden in Italy would climb to 43.5 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) this year from 42.5 percent in 1996 and 41.7 percent in 1995.
